bundle.shortDescription: Pigma — open-source design editor with a local MCP endpoint
bundle.longDescription: Pigma is a local-first design editor. The desktop build serves the same editor, exposes the MCP endpoint on loopback HTTP (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp) and speaks the same Rooms protocol. No accounts, no cloud dependency.
